sources.sectionDescription: Manage data sources (SQL / Trino / MongoDB / Redis / Elasticsearch / HTTP API) for the agent to query read-only in chat.
sources.passwordEditHint: Leave blank to keep the current password
sources.sshHint: Connect to the database through an SSH bastion (local port forward).
sources.sshPrivateKeyHint: PEM-encoded key. Passphrase-protected keys are not supported — decrypt it locally first. Stored encrypted.
sources.sshPrivateKeyStoredHint: A key is already stored; leave blank to keep it, or paste a new one to replace it.
sources.sshHostKeyHint: SHA256 fingerprint of the bastion's host key (e.g. SHA256:abc…). When set, the connection is rejected unless it matches. Blank accepts any host key.
sources.httpHeadersHint: JSON object of headers sent with every request (e.g. an auth token). Stored encrypted.
sources.httpHeadersEditHint: Headers are hidden for security; leave blank to keep the stored ones.
sources.httpListPathHint: Default unpack rule: a dotted path to the array inside the response to expand into rows (e.g. data.list). Blank = use the response as-is (top-level array → rows, object → one row). A query can override this per request.
sources.mongoUriHint: Single-host mongodb:// URI; query parameters (e.g. authSource) are passed to the driver. mongodb+srv is not supported.
sources.mongoUriEditHint: For security the password is not shown in the URI; leave the password segment empty to keep the stored one — the rest follows the URI.
sources.esApiKeyEditHint: Leave blank to keep the current API key
sources.scopeDatabasesTrinoHint: Trino reads this list as catalogs; leaving it blank exposes every federated catalog — list the allowed catalogs explicitly.
sources.scopeAllowLabel: Allowed tables allow-list (comma-separated; blank = no limit)
sources.scopeHttpHint: For HTTP sources these are request path PREFIXES (e.g. /v1/pets). Blank allow-list = no path limit; deny wins.
sources.scopeMethodsLabel: Allowed HTTP methods (comma-separated; blank = no limit)
sources.scopeMethodsHint: Restrict which verbs may pass, e.g. GET, POST. Blank allows all whitelisted verbs (GET/HEAD/POST as reads, PUT/PATCH/DELETE as writes subject to access mode).
sources.bindingsHint: Choose which projects can see this data source. An agent sees it only through its workspace’s project. A source with no project is invisible to every agent.
sources.bindingsEmpty: Not associated — invisible to all agents
